fit_method: Separate ordinary least squares regressions of raw brain-PAD on an intercept and centred chronological age for each output.

units.slope_years_per_year: years of brain-PAD per chronological-age year

provenance.export: Original coefficient decimal strings preserved; output names mapped to the public prediction schema. No refitting.

application: Coefficients are frozen. No parameters are estimated in a new evaluation sample. Chronological age is required; corrected age is an age-dependent derived measure.
scope: For the bundled selected model and ROI ordering only. Ages outside the validation range are extrapolations. Correction does not guarantee absent age dependence in a new cohort.
